description: This interface defines methods for calculating payment periods within a year and interest charging periods based on repayment frequency and date parameters, used in loan scheduling logic.

classes.name: PaymentPeriodsInOneYearCalculator
classes.description: An interface declaring methods to calculate payment periods and interest charging periods for loan repayment scheduling.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates the number of payment periods in one year based on the provided repayment frequency type.

methods.name: calculatePortionOfRepaymentPeriodInterestChargingGrace
methods.description: Calculates the portion of interest to be charged during a repayment period, considering start and due dates, interest start date, repayment frequency, and amount repaid.

calls: LocalDate (methods like isBefore, isAfter, plusDays, etc.)
